scope: Standalone wolf painting and face study. Existing Sunward/Inkbound games and viewer ZIP unchanged. The game world has not been restyled in this pass.

paint.coat: Baked warm/cool underwashes, directional fur pigment and runtime object-space granulation/pooling. Form lighting softened while preserving shadow definition.
paint.red: Granular vermilion, darker pooled edges, variable coverage and a fine softened fringe.
paint.outlines: Existing split silhouette/fur passes retained; spatially varied stroke width and dark-to-dilute pigment.
paint.stability: Pigment noise uses undeformed local coordinates, with no animated screen-noise filter.
paint.eyes: Fitted cheek artwork with narrower curved openings, round pupils, muted amber irises, small highlights and softened brows. Eyelids compress the painted skin during irregularly timed blinks.

video.source: Actual Chromium/Three.js capture; final captions overlaid with FFmpeg. No generated wolf images or retouched model surfaces.
shots: 3–6 s: longer head profile and painted markings
6–9 s: walking with wash colours and flowing fur
9–12 s: running with stable surface pigment

revisionsReviewed: First head/paint pass: length and ears retained; replaced overly round eyes and a vertical pupil with a narrower opening and round pupil. Restored stronger vermilion after the initial wash became too pale.
Second pass: deeper pigment and larger coat washes reviewed. Reduced the lower red eye sweep after it read too heavily beneath the opening.
Third pass: reviewed front/profile/three-quarter and open/half/closed eye renders; then inspected sampled video frames through blink, walk and run.
validation: Vite production build passed. Source and built GLB hashes match.
Production viewer loaded without page or shader console errors; two outline passes, face dynamics, 30 fur controls, 22 clips and 48 corrective targets present.
All three skin bindings normalized, finite and nonnegative. Native topology check: no open/nonmanifold edges.
58,040 vertices outside the head adjustment remain at exactly the approved coordinates; body and curl topology retained.
Blink image differences localized to the eye region; capture reaches full closure and reopens.
Passive-tail stability, segment-length constraints, transitions and finite motion across all 22 clips passed.
MP4 has 288 frames at 24 fps; complete FFmpeg decode passed.
limitations: Combat animation design is retained and was not exhaustively visually reviewed. Real-time painting, ink and eyelid effects require the documented viewer modules alongside the GLB.
